_comment: Maps rows of the CP's 'Invoice Summary' table to internal keys. Anchored on Sl No (most robust) with label aliases as fallback if Sl No is missing/renumbered. Edit this file, not the parser, when the CP's email format changes.

fields.note: First 'Client Name' row = the client company (e.g. Bandhan Bank).
Second 'Client Name' row = the named contact person at the client.
Often blank in practice; flagged as a warning, not a hard failure, since MIS validation is a later phase.

Not part of the original 11-field CP email — added so the invoice PDF can show the client's full address if a CP includes it. Safe to leave out entirely; existing emails without this row are unaffected. Moved from Sl No 12 to 15 on 2026-08-13 to free up 12 for the new 'Currency' field below (per instruction: 'here will be 12. currency...') — colliding two fields on the same Sl No would make them silently pick up each other's value whenever a real email numbers a row 12, so this had to move rather than just being left alone.
Poland invoices show a PO No./PO Dt. pair. Optional — only rendered if present.

NEW 2026-08-13, per explicit instruction ('here will be 12. currency: inr/dollar will be added in the body'). e.g. 'INR' or 'Dollar' -- normalized to a standard 3-letter code (see parse_invoice_summary.py's CURRENCY_ALIASES) before being written to the tab's Currency column. Optional: if this row is missing from the email, the tab's own 'default_currency' (config/tabs/*.json) is used instead, same as before this field existed.
